market_context: The Nasdaq-100 plunged 6.36% to 26,629.81 (QQQ −6.49% to $647.05)—its worst day since April 2025—as post-midterm fears of slower AI data-center buildouts collided with soft Qualcomm and Arm guidance, crushing chips, memory and AI software.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-05 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.
